explication: CubeSandbox provides hardware-isolated, E2B-compatible sandboxes, from API requests through cluster placement to a per-sandbox microVM. Its major capabilities include templates, snapshots and cross-node resume, volumes, and sandbox networking; CubeOps covers separate node management. The map follows documented product boundaries and the sampled route, workflow, storage, and network code. Several internal connections are inferred from module roles and the README rather than inspected call sites, so uncertain wiring is omitted.
